title: 3 Couple Therapists reveal secrets to 100x love life, marriage, intimacy & relationship - G2G
creator: Rahul Jain
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions (Good 2 Great podcast collaboration)
summary: A Good 2 Great podcast episode hosted as a Rahul Jain collaboration, featuring three relationship therapists: psychiatrist Dr. Shaurya Garg (AIIMS Delhi), couple therapist Shivani Misri Sadhu, and clinical psychologist Anushka Modi. The conversation breaks down what disrespect looks like in modern relationships — yelling, gaslighting, contempt and stonewalling, with the claim that 85% of men are stonewallers. They cite Gottman's research on predicting relationship survival from a 15-minute argument, discuss the signs that a marriage is beyond saving versus worth fighting for, the role money and financial stress play in partnerships, and the observation that the first three minutes of a difficult conversation decide whether it escalates or resolves. The episode is entirely about relationships and marriage; no markets, tickers or investment advice appear anywhere. No explicit calls in this one.
